artifacts.summary: Confirms the hard-mode agent-routing downgrade, argues the fix belongs in command-route-agent.sh (not the shared lib), verifies the 14-of-19-extension inventory, designs the routing_agents_hard -> routing_agents -> default_agent ladder, and specifies the Assert 3 test amendment.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's routing consolidation, manifest-routing-lib.sh's routing_lookup() is deliberately a single-block primitive (one $block arg, e.g. "routing" or "routing_agents"). Multi-block fallback composition (e.g. hard-mode-falls-back-to-standard) is each CONSUMER script's own responsibility -- command-route-skill.sh already implements this by calling routing_lookup() twice and combining results, while command-route-agent.sh's hard mode called it only once, silently losing the standard-block fallback. When two sibling resolver scripts share a library primitive but diverge in composition, check whether one embodies the correct policy and the other is just missing a step, rather than assuming both encode considered, independently-arrived-at design choices.
